name: Fear + uncrowded-funding double contrarian — buy capitulation only when leverage is not stacked
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (a CONFLUENCE distinct from fear-greed-contrarian [sentiment only] and funding-reset-reversion [funding+RSI]; here two ORTHOGONAL crowding gauges must agree): the classic dip-buy trap is buying extreme FEAR while leverage is still stacked LONG — funding positive — because that crowd hasn't capitulated yet and the squeeze is still ahead. The honest capitulation signal requires BOTH the sentiment crowd to be washed out (fear_greed at an extreme low) AND the leverage crowd to be uncrowded or net-short (funding at/below zero) — i.e. the spot AND the perp crowd have BOTH given up. That joint condition marks true positioning exhaustion, the precondition for a durable bottom, and filters out the false 'fear with longs still levered' bounces that fail. fear_greed (spot sentiment) and funding_rate (perp leverage) are genuinely orthogonal crowding reads, so the AND is more than a redundant double-count. Entry: fear_greed below a fitted fear floor AND funding_rate below a fitted uncrowded ceiling (at/below zero — shorts paying or neutral) AND price not in structural freefall (trend floor = knife guard). Exit: fear_greed crosses up into greed (sentiment recovered) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if fear_greed ALONE (the existing contrarian spec) does as well, the funding leg is redundant and the double-contrarian thesis is unsupported. Disconfirmer 2: if an unconditional dip-buy matches the deflated Sharpe, neither crowding gauge adds anything. Disconfirmer 3: the AND must not so thin the sample it fails the gate's min-trades floor — if it does, that is honest evidence the joint capitulation is too rare. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): the bounce must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 sentiment + tier0 funding features.
catalyst: extreme fear AND uncrowded/net-short funding together — true two-sided positioning capitulation
